def comps(g):

from scipy import ndimage
def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g); out=[]
    for v in sorted(set(g.flatten())):
        if v==0: continue
        m=g==v
        lab,n = ndimage.label(m, structure=np.ones((3,3)))
        for i in range(1,n+1):

            box=(int(ys.min()),int(xs.min()),int(ys.max()),int(xs.max()))

        for i in range(1,n+1):

            out.append({'v':int(v),'cells':[(int(y),int(x)) for y,x in zip(ys,xs)],'pos':(int(ys.min()),int(xs.min())),'size':len(ys)})

    # same-shape partners (any color)

    # nearest object by min cell manhattan
    near=sorted([(min(abs(a[0]-b[0])+abs(a[1]-b[1]) for a in tgt['cells'] for b in o['cells']),o['v'],o['size']) for o in objs if o is not tgt])
    print('==',k,'bg=',np.bincount(A.flatten()).argmax(),'changed v=%d->%d size=%d pos=%s'%(tgt['v'],newc,tgt['size'],tgt['pos']))

import os,re,numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g); out=[]
    for v in sorted(set(g.flatten())):
        if v==8: continue
        m=g==v
        lab,n=ndimage.label(m,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
            out.append({'v':int(v),'cells':[(int(y),int(x)) for y,x in zip(ys,xs)],'pos':(int(ys.min()),int(xs.min())),'size':len(ys)})
    return out
def norm(cells):
    ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    return tuple(sorted((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cells))
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    A=np.array(G[k+' input']); B=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    diff=[(i,j,A[i][j],B[i][j]) for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(len(A[0])) if A[i][j]!=B[i][j]]
    tgt=[c for c in comps(A) if any(p in c['cells'] for p in [(i,j) for i,j,v,_ in diff])]
    tgt=tgt[0]; newc=diff[0][3]
    objs=comps(A)
    print('==',k,'bg=',np.bincount(A.flatten()).argmax(),'changed v=%d->%d'%(tgt['v'],newc))
    print('  all objs:',[(o['v'],o['size'],o['pos']) for o in sorted(objs,key=lambda o:-o['size'])])
    # same-shape partners of changed (any color, incl bg-colored if any)
    parts=[o for o in objs if norm(o['cells'])==norm(tgt['cells']) and o is not tgt]
    print('  dup-shape partners:',[(p['v'],p['pos']) for p in parts])

import os,re,numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g):
    g=np.array(g); out=[]
    for v in sorted(set(g.flatten())):
        if v==8: continue
        m=g==v
        lab,n=ndimage.label(m,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
            out.append({'v':int(v),'cells':[(int(y),int(x)) for y,x in zip(ys,xs)],'pos':(int(ys.min()),int(xs.min())),'size':len(ys)})
    return out
def norm(cells):
    ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    return tuple(sorted((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cells))
def mindist(a,b):
    return min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for p in a['cells'] for q in b['cells'])

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    A=np.array(G[k+' input']); B=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    diff=[(i,j,A[i][j],B[i][j]) for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(len(A[0])) if A[i][j]!=B[i][j]]
    tgt=[c for c in comps(A) if any(p in c['cells'] for p in [(i,j) for i,j,v,_ in diff])]
    tgt=tgt[0]; newc=diff[0][3]
    objs=comps(A)
    bgc=int(np.bincount(A.flatten()).argmax())
    # unique-color objects (color appears exactly once)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(o['v'] for o in objs)
    uniq=[o for o in objs if cnt[o['v']]==1]
    largest=max([o for o in objs if o['v']!=bgc],key=lambda o:o['size'])
    # same-shape diff-color pairs involving changed
    shpairs=[(o for o in objs if norm(o['cells'])==norm(tgt['cells']) and o is not tgt)]
    info={'tgt':tgt,'newc':newc,'uniq':[(o['v'],o['size'],o['pos']) for o in uniq],'largest':(largest['v'],largest['size'],largest['pos']),
          'shparts':[(p['v'],p['size'],mindist(tgt,p)) for p in shpairs]}
    print('==',k,'tgt v=%d size=%d pos=%s -> %d'%(tgt['v'],tgt['size'],tgt['pos'],newc))
    print('   unique-color objs:',info['uniq'])
    print('   largest non-bg:',info['largest'])
    print('   same-shape partners:',info['shparts'])

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    A=np.array(G[k+' input']); B=np.array(G[k+' output'])
    diff=[(i,j,A[i][j],B[i][j]) for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(len(A[0])) if A[i][j]!=B[i][j]]

    from collections import Counter as C
    cc=C(o['v'] for o in objs); szc=C(o['size'] for o in objs)

    # is target the unique-color object? is it smallest? largest? etc.

    small=sorted(objs,key=lambda o:o['size'])
    print('  unique-color objs:',[(u['v'],u['pos'],u['size']) for u in uniq])
    print('  target in uniq?',any(u is tgt[0] for u in uniq),'target rank by size:',sorted(objs,key=lambda o:o['size']).index(tgt[0])+1,'of',len(objs))
    # shape partners of target
    shp=[(mindist(tgt[0],o),o['v'],norm(o['cells'])) for o in objs if o is not tgt[0] and norm(o['cells'])==norm(tgt[0]['cells'])]

import os,re,numpy as np
from collections import Counter as C, defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    objs=[]
    for v in sorted(set(g.flatten())):
        if v==bg: continue
        lab,n=ndimage.label(g==v,structure=np.ones((3,3)))
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            ys,xs=np.where(lab==i)
            cells=[(int(y),int(x)) for y,x in zip(ys,xs)]
            objs.append({'v':v,'cells':cells,'pos':tuple(sorted(cells)[0]),'size':len(cells)})
    return objs

    g=np.array(G[k+' input']); B=np.array(G[k+' output'])

    objs=comps(g,bg)

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; bgc=int(np.bincount([int(x) for r in gi for x in r]).argmax())

def solve(g):
    bg=int(np.bincount([x for r_ in g for x in r_]).argmax())
    o=comps(g,bg)
    cnt=Counter(x['v'] for x in o)
    u=max((x for x in o if cnt[x['v']]==1),key=lambda x:x['size'])
    def d(a,b): return min(abs(y1-y2)+abs(x1-x2) for y1,x1 in a for y2,x2 in b)
    pairs=[]
    for i in range(len(o)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(o)):
            if o[i]['v']!=o[j]['v'] and canon(o[i]['cells'])==canon(o[j]['cells']):
                pairs.append((d(o[i]['cells'],u['cells']),d(o[j]['cells'],u['cells']),o[i],o[j]))
    if not pairs: return [row[:] for row in g]
    # target = pair member farther from big; tie-break max separation between pair members

        key=(sep,max(da,db))
        if best is None or key>best[0]: best=(key,best[1])
    tgt=best[1]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for y,x in tgt['cells']: res[y][x]=u['v']
    return res
